'''Bashka''' was a [[City/Legends|village]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] that, like most [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] settlements, was carved into a cavern of a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]]. It was located along the thin line that separated the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] between the blistering heat of the [[Bright Lands]] and the [[Death/Legends|deadly]] cold of night side. Bashka did not have much in the way of organized establishments, but during the final days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] a Twi'lek named [[Cheib'Kalla]] owned and operated a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] called the [[Fungus Pit]] and turned it into a popular attraction for local residents.
